content_blocks.title: Worked example: Customizing ModelAdmin
content_blocks.code:
from django.contrib import admin

# Register the model you want staff to manage.
admin.site.register(Book)
content_blocks.expected_output: Once registered, staff with the appropriate model permissions can manage Book records in the admin interface.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Open a local project using the documented Django 6.1-compatible Python environment. If this snippet depends on model names, URL configuration, settings, or an optional package, add those prerequisites before running it. Otherwise inspect it as a static example. CodeLeaf browser preview does not execute Django/Python server code.
content_blocks.troubleshooting: The Book model must be imported and the admin site configured. Do not grant broad staff permissions by default.
